title: Hydrographer
summary: HYDROG'RAPHER, noun [See Hydrography.] One who draws maps of the sea, lakes or other waters, with the adjacent shores; one who describes the sea or other waters.

inlines.v: HYDROG'RAPHER, noun [See Hydrography.] One who draws maps of the sea, lakes or other waters, with the adjacent shores; one who describes the sea or other waters.
